pattern.description: Chat thread inside the left 'Customer conversation' panel scrolls up: the previous agent message and 'Please' reply slide up and out, the new agent reply rises from the bottom into the top slot, then the customer's reply bubble and avatar enter below it.
pattern.why_premium: Messages advance like a real chat feed with one continuous upward scroll instead of hard swaps, keeping the reading position fixed while the side-by-side reasoning panel stays static for context.

build_hint.gsap: Thread container inside an overflow-hidden panel: gsap.to(thread, {y: '-=rowHeight', duration: 0.6, ease: 'power3.out'}); new agent row gsap.fromTo(agentRow, {y: 80, autoAlpha: 0}, {y: 0, autoAlpha: 1, duration: 0.6, ease: 'power3.out'}); then customer row (bubble + avatar) gsap.fromTo(customerRow, {y: 24, autoAlpha: 0}, {y: 0, autoAlpha: 1, duration: 0.4, ease: 'power2.out'}, '+=0.5').
build_hint.remotion: translateY of the thread driven by spring({frame, fps, config: {damping: 200, stiffness: 120}}) (no overshoot); customer row delayed ~15 frames with interpolate opacity 0->1 and translateY 24->0 on its own non-overshooting spring.

notes: camera.move is none; pan_y reflects the in-panel chat scroll, not a camera move. The outgoing messages are off-frame at the end so they have no box. b02 is a diff region that also overlaps the customer bubble; used for the agent bubble since no tighter bubble box exists (b04/b08/b07 are its individual text lines).
